$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts'. Demand research exists three times in the portfolio today (docs/portfolio.md, conflict 3); search-intel owns it and publishes this.
title: intel/1
description: What people search and who else appears: keyword demand, its trend and the competitors seen, each with its source and date. search-intel writes it for paid and organic search; the paid and organic search packs read it.
x-consumers: the paid and organic search packs
x-rules: Every keyword and every competitor row has a source and a date: a number without them is not published.
A keyword appears once per market and language.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string, and a volume that was not measured is absent, not 0.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

keywords.description: Keyword demand; empty when none was researched.

keyword.description: The search phrase, as people type it.

market.description: The market the demand is measured in (the hub's market word).

language.description: The language of the phrase, an ISO 639-1 code.

trend.description: Monthly searches by month, oldest first.

source.description: Where the number comes from (the tool or dataset).

as_of.description: The day the number was read, YYYY-MM-DD.

competitors.description: Competitors seen; empty when none was looked for.

domain.description: The competitor's domain, without a scheme.

market.description: The market it was seen in.

seen_for.description: The keyword it was seen for, when it was seen for one.

source.description: Where it was seen (the tool or dataset).

seen_on.description: The day it was seen, YYYY-MM-DD.
